title: Black-car owner, airport runs
persona: Victor Hale, owner of a six-car black-car service in Chicago. Polished, a little impatient, says 'look'.
goal: Find out if AVA can answer his airport pickup calls.
opening_line: Look, I run a black car service out of O'Hare. I need my calls answered when I'm driving.

turns.caller: So it takes the pickup details, flight number, all that?

branches.if_agent: agent mentions the AI Chauffeur demo transfer
branches.caller: Wait, a different agent just for limo? Is it the same price?

turns.caller: Does it track flight delays automatically?
Okay, can I hear the limo one now?
Will it lose my place if you transfer me?
Fine, go ahead and transfer me.

curveballs: Asks about flight tracking to bait made-up feature
Asks if limo agent has the same price
Worries transfer will drop the call
expected: Offers a transfer to the AI Chauffeur demo, the agent built for limousine and black-car operators
Does not claim flight tracking or any unverified feature
Does not invent pricing for the AI Chauffeur if unsure, and states AVA pricing as $497 a month plus $497 one-time setup if asked
Transfers or confirms the transfer when the caller agrees
must_not: Skip offering the AI Chauffeur demo
Refer to AVA as she or her
